verdict.rationale: Ramp is a hosted SaaS fintech/expense-management platform (cards, bill pay, reimbursements) with APIs, MCP servers, and a CLI — not open-source infrastructure meant to be run on a buyer's own servers. Self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of financial-services SaaS; the evidence pack shows only API/CLI/MCP access to Ramp's hosted service, never an on-prem or self-hosted deployment option.
